target_customer: B2B and B2C companies running paid social ads
problem: Brands struggle to produce enough video creative for Meta ads.
business_model: Agency-style subscription starting at $5,000 per month; earlier SaaS plans for explainer videos

founders.name: Ritam Rana
founders.background_notes: Press profile says the team began as University of Florida students; not opened for education details.

founders.name: Ritvik Varada
founders.background_notes: YC page: former quant at WorldQuant.

competitors.name: Synthesia
competitors.what: AI avatar talking-head video from scripts

technical_complexity.rationale: Generative video pipelines assembled from existing models plus a human-in-the-loop production process.

defensibility.rationale: Agency work with commodity models; scale and creative testing data are the only edges.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals kept raising capital; Creatify raised a $15.5M Series A in May 2025. No action against Knowlify found.

market_need_then: Founders say they ran Meta ads and could not produce enough creative; ad creative volume is a known bottleneck.

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand press. Name resembles Knowify and KnowledgeOwl, and no longer fits the ad agency pitch.

pivots.from: AI explainer video maker turning documents into animated videos
pivots.to: Done-for-you AI video ads agency for Meta ads
pivots.why: Not stated by the company; the YC and press descriptions say explainer maker while the site and YC page now say ads agency. Date unclear.

outcome_analysis: Knowlify began as an AI explainer video tool and moved to selling done-for-you Meta video ads at a high monthly price. Press reported a $3M raise in October 2025 but named no investors. No exit or shutdown found as of 2026-11. The pivot toward services suggests the self-serve tool market was crowded with well funded rivals.
notes: Two outlets (American Bazaar, Signalbase) report $3M; no primary release and no investors named, so partial coverage. Neuronfeed says $3.5M total over two rounds and VCBacked lists a $500K pre-seed in Sep 2025 from YC; not recorded. Founder education not read from a source I opened. Pivot interpretation is mine from conflicting descriptions.
